# brief: script-writer-final

## job
Write the FINAL narration script for the episode. This is what the voice actor reads. No placeholders, no [TBD].

## format
- Two hosts: MAYA (pro: remote work is fine for cities) and OWEN (con: city centres are dying)
- 8 beats, total runtime 9-10 min (~1350-1500 words spoken)
- Each beat: speaker label, spoken lines only. Stage notes in (parentheses), max one per beat.

## beats (approved outline r3)
1. Cold open: empty office tower at 10am on a Tuesday. OWEN sets the hook.
2. MAYA: office vacancy numbers vs. residential conversions; the city is changing, not dying.
3. OWEN: lunch economy - cafes, dry cleaners, shoe repair closing near business districts.
4. MAYA: commuting hours given back; people spend locally in their own neighbourhoods.
5. OWEN: tax base problem - commercial property taxes fund transit.
6. Clash beat: both on public transit ridership. Short lines, fast back-and-forth.
7. Common ground: hybrid 3-day weeks, mixed-use zoning.
8. Close: each host one sentence verdict, then shared outro line.

## facts you may use (verified)
- Office occupancy in large Western cities averages ~50-60% of pre-2020 levels
- Several cities run office-to-housing conversion incentives
- Transit agencies report weekday ridership below pre-2020, weekends recovered faster
Do NOT invent statistics beyond these. Use "about", "roughly".

## voice
Smart, warm, a bit sharp. No clichés ("in today's world", "game-changer"). Sentences short enough to read aloud in one breath.

# Bookwell - product notes (internal)

What it is: online booking + reminders for small clinics (dentists, physio, vets). 1-10 staff.

Main pains we solve:
- no-shows (SMS + WhatsApp reminders 24h and 2h before)
- phone ringing all day for simple bookings
- double bookings on paper calendars

Features:
- booking page clinic can share / embed on site
- reminders, patient can confirm or reschedule from the message
- staff calendar, works on phone
- simple deposit for first visit (optional)

Proof:
- pilot clinics cut no-shows roughly by a third
- setup takes under 30 min, we help on a call

Pricing: free 14 day trial, no card. Monthly plan per clinic.

Objections we hear:
- "my patients are old, they won't book online" -> they can still call, reminders work for everyone
- "is patient data safe" -> encrypted, EU servers
- "I already use Google Calendar" -> two-way sync
- "can I cancel" -> anytime, export your data

CTA: Start free trial
